narration.opening: This is Eterna: the control layer for agents that act on the XRP Ledger.
narration.problem: Rose is a CFO rolling out a team of AI agents. Every agent account needs XRP for fees and reserves — idle money spread across wallets she has to fund, track and recover.
narration.solution: With XRPL’s new Sponsored Fees and Reserves, Eterna can pay those costs for her agents — but only under the policy Rose approved.
narration.transaction: Her agent submits its transaction. Eterna checks it against Rose’s policy and co-signs as sponsor. The agent holds no XRP for the fee or the reserve.
narration.proof: This is XRPL Devnet, with the Sponsor amendment enabled. Here is the transaction hash. The ledger records Eterna as the sponsor.
narration.outcome: Rose’s agent is working, her XRP stays in one place, and every sponsored cost is on the record.
narration.closing: Sponsored by policy. Verified on the ledger.
